stem: A nutrient program raises one element while tissue analysis shows a decline in another and plant performance does not improve. What should be considered before increasing inputs again?
choices: Nutrient interactions, root-zone chemistry and developmental context
Only the label rate of the increased nutrient
The assumption that more of every nutrient is beneficial
rationale: Mineral nutrition involves interacting ions and plant context. Increasing one nutrient can alter uptake or balance of others without improving performance.
